## Triage and Containment Actions

1. **Block** — domain-name at the DNS resolver and web proxy; file at the EDR hash blocklist; ipv4-addr at the firewall and proxy; ipv6-addr at the firewall and proxy; url at the web proxy _(owner: SOC)_
2. **Search** — the last 30 days of DNS and proxy logs; EDR file and process events; firewall, proxy and NetFlow logs; proxy logs for the listed indicators _(owner: SOC)_
3. **Isolate** — any host that resolved, connected to or executed a listed indicator, and escalate to incident response _(owner: Incident response)_
